structured_output.what_is_happening: METSUMI (Metsumi404) is a Meteora-launched token with a real, working concept: 4,444 tokens and 4,444 "terminals". You burn one token to permanently "hardwire" a terminal, and lit terminals receive a share of trading fees paid in $MET. It launched on Meteora's virtual curve at about 18:10 UTC, migrated within about 2 minutes, and quickly reached an all-time-high (ATH) price of about $106.8 (roughly $470k market cap). It has since fallen about 75% to about $26 (about $115k market cap), with -57% over the last hour and a +25% bounce over the last 5 minutes. Most trading is on the METSUMI/MET pool: $30k liquidity and $289k of volume in the last hour. At the same time, a copycat token called "Metsumi404" launched on PumpSwap (3f7fo…) at about 19:01 UTC. That copycat is taking far more flow: about $925k of volume in the last hour, +158% over the hour, and a $158k market cap, which is above the real token's.

narrative.description: A '404'-style burn-to-own mechanic with fees paid out in $MET, tied to the Meteora ecosystem. The site is working and the code is public on GitHub. It is a niche mechanic, not a cultural or news event.
narrative.why_spreading: Early buying came from launchpad and Meteora-ecosystem traders plus smart wallets (36 smart and 6 renowned wallets per GMGN). The price has since halved in an hour, and attention is draining to a same-name copycat on PumpSwap. I found no organic X, Reddit or news discussion.

token_connection.why_this_token: The project website metsumi.cash lists this exact contract address, which has a vanity 'metsumi' suffix. The DexScreener profile links to the same site and to @Metsumi404.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 3f7foHXhNLNVMYpXr8DsVvpNGHjKeJ1Uc4B5XKUBzxYC is a copycat on PumpSwap with the same name. It has $925k of volume in the last hour, about $38k of liquidity and a $158k market cap. It is pulling the speculative flow away from the real token. Several dead Metsumi404 clones also exist.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 174 of 550 traders as bundler wallets and gives a bot/degen rate of 55%. It also shows 36 smart and 6 renowned wallets. There are no paid DexScreener boosts. The dev's X account has launched 15 tokens, which points to a serial launcher. There were no X search results for the handle, and I found no Reddit or Telegram discussion.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts directly, so there may be KOL posting driving this that I missed.

structural_risks: Price is down 75% from the ATH, and early buyers who are still underwater will sell into any recovery
The PumpSwap copycat is taking about 3x the volume
Liquidity is split across pairs, and the main pool is paired against MET rather than SOL, so it also moves with MET
The dev is a serial launcher

structured_output.counterargument: This is the canonical token and the product actually works. The fee-sharing burn mechanic takes supply out permanently, and the LP burn ratio is 1.0. It reached about a $470k market cap barely an hour ago, so returning to about $230k (a 2x) only means retracing half the dump, and the +25% bounce over 5 minutes is the start of that. The copycat's heavy volume could even send traders looking for the 'real' contract address, and the website points them here.

source_coverage.notes: The website and GitHub repo confirm the project. Live pair data came from the DexScreener API. X is poorly indexed by search engines.

structured_output.thesis: This is the real, canonical token with a genuine mechanic, but it is after the peak. It is down 75% from its ATH, a copycat has taken over attention, and the bundler share is high. Liquidity is burned, which lowers the chance of a hard rug. A 2x needs a strong new wave of attention, and I see none.
